reasoning: 驗證目標：在任何導致進入 360L 的系統事件發生時，系統無使用者可感知的延遲即完成轉換。為什麼這樣切：條款未給任何時間門檻（無數值、無「不大於」句），故 ER 不得自行編造秒數——編一個數字等於把未裁的驗收標準寫進交付物。可判準的替代形式是：以固定的 360L 操作組逐項觀察，並要求轉換在同一次使用者動作內完成、其間不出現中間畫面或空白畫面。門檻缺口已登錄 A-SX25 並入 RD-1（§8.4.1）。與 188 的差別：該 leaf 的觸發是使用者主動選取，本 leaf 是系統事件；條款分列且各自舉例不同（§8.2.1）。條款自附的 NOTE 界定了「進入」兼指畫面與音訊，故兩者皆為判準。

tcs.tc_title: System-initiated entry into 360L has no perceivable delay
tcs.test_item: Upon any system event that causes entry into the 360L function, the system shall transition into the 360L function without user-perceivable delay, entry meaning display of the 360L HMI and resumption of audio as appropriate
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active 360L subscription
2. IP connectivity for 360L streaming is available
3. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
4. The 360L exercise set is defined and fixed for this test: enter 360L, browse the channel list, open For You, start an On Demand episode, return to live, change channel twice, open Settings and exit 360L
5. Two system events that cause entry into 360L are available: resume on power up, and resume after a phone call ends
6. The session is recorded so that the display and audio can be reviewed frame by frame
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Power the HU up with 360L as the last used function and record the display and audio
2. Review the recording from power up to the 360L HMI being displayed and audio resuming
3. Place and end a phone call while 360L was in use, and record the display and audio
4. Review the recording from the call ending to the 360L HMI being displayed and audio resuming
tcs.expected_result:
1. The HU resumes into the 360L function
2. The 360L HMI is displayed and audio resumes without an intervening blank screen, wait indication or silent gap beyond the transition itself
3. The HU resumes into the 360L function after the call ends
4. The 360L HMI is displayed and audio resumes without an intervening blank screen, wait indication or silent gap beyond the transition itself
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
